unclassified: Incorrect answer without a defensible specific diagnosis; do not infer why.

errors.description: Basic sentence word order: form missing, misplaced or inappropriate
errors.feedback: Subject + verb + object: She reads books.

errors.description: Regular and irregular plurals: form missing, misplaced or inappropriate
errors.feedback: Use books, but children and feet.

errors.description: Word bases and stems: form missing, misplaced or inappropriate
errors.feedback: Identify the base before adding an affix.

errors.description: Prefixes: form missing, misplaced or inappropriate
errors.feedback: un- often negates an adjective; meaning depends on the word.

errors.description: Derivational suffixes: form missing, misplaced or inappropriate
errors.feedback: -ness can turn an adjective into a noun.

errors.description: Drop final silent e: form missing, misplaced or inappropriate
errors.feedback: Usually drop silent e before -ing: make → making; see → seeing is an exception.

errors.description: Change consonant + y to i: form missing, misplaced or inappropriate
errors.feedback: Consonant + y changes before -ed: try → tried; before -ing: trying.

errors.description: Final consonant doubling: form missing, misplaced or inappropriate
errors.feedback: Double after a stressed short vowel in CVC endings: stop → stopped; visit → visited.

errors.description: Articles and determiners: form missing, misplaced or inappropriate
errors.feedback: A singular count noun usually needs a determiner: a book.

errors.description: Wrong a/an/the choice
errors.feedback: Use an before a vowel sound: an apple.

errors.description: Article used where zero article is required
errors.feedback: General plural nouns often use no article: Books are useful.

errors.description: Subject–verb agreement: form missing, misplaced or inappropriate
errors.feedback: She works; they work.

errors.description: Present simple and continuous: form missing, misplaced or inappropriate
errors.feedback: Use present continuous for an action happening now.

errors.description: Past simple: form missing, misplaced or inappropriate
errors.feedback: Regular past uses -ed; go has irregular past went.

errors.description: Regular -ed applied to an irregular verb, e.g. goed
errors.feedback: Go is irregular: its past form is went.

errors.description: Present perfect: form missing, misplaced or inappropriate
errors.feedback: Use have/has + past participle.

errors.description: Future forms: form missing, misplaced or inappropriate
errors.feedback: Will + base verb is one way to express a future prediction.

errors.description: Prepositions of time and place: form missing, misplaced or inappropriate
errors.feedback: Use on Monday, in June, at noon.

errors.description: Comparatives and superlatives: form missing, misplaced or inappropriate
errors.feedback: Use taller, happier, and more interesting.

errors.description: Questions and negation: form missing, misplaced or inappropriate
errors.feedback: Use does + base verb: Does she work?

errors.description: Zero, first and second conditionals: form missing, misplaced or inappropriate
errors.feedback: First conditional: if + present, will + base verb.
